description: Build an UNSIGNED approve(tokenId) or setApprovalForAll (or a revoke with approved=false) for a BlazarForce NFT, with warnings for unknown operators and approve-all. the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

collection.description: Collection symbol, id or address: SLPV (Sleepy Validators), STUB (Night Market Stubs), MOTH (Crystal Moths).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

operator.description: Address allowed to move the NFT(s), e.g. a marketplace.

name: blazar_build_nft_approve

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.

title: Build NFT approve / revoke (unsigned)
